title: Witch with Golden Egg Hammer
description: A blue-skinned anime-style witch with short black hair kneels on a black and white checkered floor, holding a large ornate hammer. She wears a revealing blue outfit with a golden egg balanced on her head, set against a black and white gothic building silhouette with vibrant dripping paint and colorful autumn maple leaves falling around her.
prompt: A blue-skinned anime witch with short black hair and large eyes kneels confidently on a black and white checkered floor, one hand on her hip and the other holding a large ornate silver and black hammer. A large golden egg with blue details rests on her head surrounded by smaller colored eggs. She wears a revealing blue ruffled outfit and boots. Behind her is a stark black and white silhouette of a gothic cathedral. Colorful dripping paint in pink, orange, and yellow falls from the top of the frame alongside bright autumn maple leaves. Text on the right reads 'there's spells here but I'm not casting spells, just present'
